title: Heartelfie — U.S. Heart & Circulatory Wellness Atlas
source: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER — schema-compatible with CDC PLACES (age-adjusted prevalence). Not real data.

measures.label: Circulatory Strain
measures.description: Community-level heart & circulatory wellness-awareness indicator for adults aged ≥18, from CDC PLACES public-health estimates (age-adjusted). Describes geographic areas, never individuals.

measures.label: Heart Health
measures.description: Community-level heart-health awareness indicator for adults aged ≥18, from CDC PLACES public-health estimates (age-adjusted). Describes geographic areas, never individuals.

measures.label: Brain Circulation
measures.description: Community-level brain-circulation wellness-awareness indicator for adults aged ≥18, from CDC PLACES public-health estimates (age-adjusted). Describes geographic areas, never individuals.

notes: These numbers are SYNTHETIC and for layout/QA only — do not cite them.
Geography is realistic (the Southeast & Appalachia run higher) but values are generated, not measured.
State values are the unweighted mean of their counties.
Run `npm run data:scrape` after allowlisting data.cdc.gov to replace with real CDC PLACES data.
